verdict.rationale: Devin runs tasks as cloud-based sessions with their own VM, accessible via browser, IDE, Slack/Teams, CLI, or API, and 'Devin Handoff' explicitly supports continuing work across sessions/agents/devices even after closing your laptop. This directly supports starting a task on one device and resuming from another via the persistent cloud session. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of seamless cross-device session continuity and any UI-level session sync details beyond docs claims.
